capabilities: Chat with free AI models from the sidebar
Run agent tools that create, rewrite, move, and tag notes with an approval step
Read web pages and search the web via web_read and web_search tools
Dictate text using built-in or cloud speech-to-text providers
Translate, summarize, calculate, or explain the current note with one-click quick tools
extras: Free monthly token and web allowances are per device and capped per network; more tokens are available via usefree.space. Includes a power-user eval_js tool that can run JavaScript inside Obsidian; it is off by default and must be enabled in settings. Notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat or agent, and most AI plugins require an account or a paid API key before they are usable.

relations.evidence: using the free web allowance or your own Jina key
Cloud providers (Groq, OpenAI) remain available as alternatives

requires.name: provider API key (OpenAI, Groq, Jina, any provider)

summary: Sidebar AI assistant with free monthly tokens and agent tools that read, search, write, move, and tag vault notes after user approval.
